lead.headline: Asian markets tumble 7% in a semiconductor selloff following warnings of AI overheating
lead.body: South Korea's equity benchmark dropped sharply after global semiconductor stocks slid amid growing worries about artificial intelligence overheating and intense competition from China. Major tech names like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix both saw their shares fall more than 8%.
lead.why: Understanding how macro chip sentiment shifts valuation multiples will help you analyze tech sector risk during your finance and investing coursework.

stories.headline: Kroger plans to cut 3,000 corporate jobs over the next three years
stories.body: CEO Greg Foran stated in an internal memo that the grocery chain has too many layers, handoffs, and overhead. The reduction aims to streamline corporate operations.
stories.why: This is a classic operational restructuring case study on eliminating middle-management overhead to expand margins, directly relevant to your Merage business strategy classes.

stories.headline: SpaceX secures low-band spectrum licenses for Starlink Mobile service
stories.body: SpaceX announced that Starlink Mobile will gain access to up to 14 megahertz of paired, low-band spectrum across nationwide 800 MHz licenses. The move positions the satellite company to directly compete with traditional carriers like T-Mobile and AT&T.
stories.why: Analyzing how a disruptive infrastructure provider enters existing oligopolies gives you a framework for competitive strategy and telecom market disruption.

term.name: Model Distillation
term.definition: Model distillation is a machine learning technique where a smaller, more efficient AI model is trained using the outputs of a larger, more powerful frontier model. As seen in Anthropic's recent security updates, labs fiercely protect their proprietary models against this practice because it allows competitors to cheaply replicate advanced capabilities without spending billions on foundational research.
